results.caption: The wife of singer Rag ’n Bone Man has been spared jail after admitting causing serious injury by careless driving. Zoe Graham says she was running late for the school run when she overtook a line of cars, illegally crossing a double white line. She hit another car at 50mph - with a Mum and three children inside - in Sussex on August 9, 2023. Mum, Samantha Keen was left with serious injuries. Zoe Graham has apologised and was sentenced to 12 weeks prison, suspended for 18 months, and banned from driving for a year.

results.caption: Every neighborhood has that one restaurant that feels like home. ❤️ I had the best time spending the day with Juliet and Justine at @TheEdgeHarlem with @Mastercard, who’s celebrating small businesses through grants, mentorship, tools, and resources to help them grow and thrive. Getting a behind-the-scenes look at everything that goes into running their restaurant was a reminder that small businesses do so much more than serve food—they build community. From the prep work and big decisions to the creativity, hospitality, and heart poured into every meal, their passion is evident in everything they do. That’s why I was so excited to surprise The Edge with a $10,000 grant to support their journey. Helping build dreams that strengthen communities: #priceless. Stay tuned as I check back in to follow The Edge’s journey! ❤️ #MastercardPartner #SmallBusiness #Harlem #SupportSmallBusines
results.profileBio: Chef, author, TV personality. Watch me on the Holiday Baking Shows!
results.transcript: I'm at The Edge in Harlem, an amazing restaurant owned by two sisters. Hi! Welcome to The Edge. As part of MasterCard's mission, to celebrate small businesses, we're spotlighting stories just like these. So good to see you. So who do you serve? So we serve our local community. Talk to me about some pain points that you all have. Something is leaking, POS isn't working. You have to just get very good at solving problems in the moment. As a chef and business owner myself, I'm always curious about the moments people don't see, and the small choices that help build something meaningful. So when you dream about what this place could be, what does that look like? We'd love to buy a new tables and chairs, repaint and just refresh our menu. By the way, this sorrel is so good. That is homemade by our father. He's an inspiration working on getting his sorrel into bottles. We're looking at the restaurant. What is next? Ignite our creativity once again. Yeah. I love that. I mean, as an entrepreneur, you just need to go out, have a fresh look, come back. Yes. Ladies, this has been incredible. To help you keep growing, MasterCard is proud to give you a $10,000 grant, plus the tools, resources, and mentorship to build your dreams. Here it is. Yes. Thank you so much. Thank you. You're so welcome. Beautiful messenger. Yes. Oh. Wow. Stay tuned with me and MasterCard to follow the Edge Harlem's journey.
